title: Quebec: Montmorency Falls and Basilica Private Half-Day Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the best of Quebec City’s surroundings on a private half-day tour, visiting Montmorency Falls and the Sainte-Anne-de-Beaupré Sanctuary with a local guide and a flexible pace.

Enjoy a relaxed and personalized experience as you visit Montmorency Falls, even higher than Niagara Falls, with time to take in scenic viewpoints and walking paths. Continue to the Basilica of Sainte-Anne-de-Beaupré, an important landmark of Quebec’s cultural and religious heritage, known for its impressive architecture and rich history.

Enhance your experience with an optional extension to Île d’Orléans, a charming island celebrated for its countryside landscapes and traditional villages. This private tour adapts to your pace and interests, offering a comfortable and enjoyable way to explore beyond Quebec City.

*Itinerary may vary depending on pace, weather, and group preferences.
